args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1. KEY AGENTS:
  * SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1 - workforce skills analysis & training recommendations
  * PerformanceReviewCycleCoordinator:v1
  * CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI, Procurement agents, OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine
  * AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator:v1 - TRACKS ASSET LIFECYCLE from inception through implementation
  * ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1 - analyzes vendor master data (agent, NOT data API)
- sap.crm: CRM - CAMPAIGN ENGAGEMENT TRACKING & MANAGEMENT:
  * CampaignAudienceOptimizationCoordinator:v1 - ORCHESTRATES campaign execution
  * CampaignAudienceOptimizationAgent:v1 - analyzes customer segments & real-time engagement metrics
- sap.ehs: Safety/health - KEY AGENTS:
  * IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 - ANALYZES SAFETY INCIDENTS & TRENDS
  * IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1
  * SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1
- sap.ariba: Procurement - **PRIMARY FOR VENDOR MASTER DATA**:
  * **PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 (REST) - EXPOSES VENDOR & PURCHASEORDER ENTITIES with specifications, enables procurement team order processing, validates vendor compliance for orders**
  * VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1 - 3-way matching (PO/Receipt/Invoice validation)
  * SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1 - HAZMAT tracking & SAFETY CERTIFICATIONS
  * MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1
  * SourceingCampaignAndAccountManagementAPI:v1
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents ONLY
- my.mes: Manufacturing:
  * EquipmentOEEAnalytics (REST API) - machine performance metrics only
  * ProductionQualityMonitor - quality inspection monitoring
  * ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1
  * SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator:v1 - PROCESSES INCOMING MATERIAL INSPECTIONS
- siemens.plm: PLM:
  * BOMComplianceValidator:v1 - VALIDATES BOM against regulatory standards
  * SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1 - SUPPLIER QUALIFICATION & MATERIAL APPROVAL (design-time)
  * EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

VENDOR DATA FOR PROCUREMENT:
- **PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 (sap.ariba)** = PRIMARY for pulling vendor specs & details for order processing - exposes Vendor entity with complete specifications, enables procurement teams to access vendor data before order creation

args.reason: Exposes Vendor and PurchaseOrder entities with complete specifications, enabling procurement teams to retrieve vendor details and validate compliance before order processing.
